1 · AI model

Any OpenAI-compatible server: Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp. It has to be reachable over the internet (this runs on Google's servers, so localhost won't work). A Cloudflare Tunnel or Tailscale Funnel in front of your machine does the trick.
Leave blank for the default.
Rules only: catches emails sent by sales tools (Apollo, Outreach, Lemlist…) and obvious templates. Add an AI key to catch the rest.

3 · Safety

In dry run, cold emails get the Cold Email label but stay in your inbox, so you can check its judgment first.

4 · Never touch these senders

One email or domain per line. When you drag an email out of Cold Email, its sender is added here automatically.
